device.modelDescription: Step module of the ch-packs family: groups a window of CI runs' failures by signature and says of each whether it is new, flaky or recurring. A pure function of its input: no disk, no network, no state.

actionList.name: group
actionList.description: Takes every run in a window (each with its conclusion, commit, branch and time, failures with their ch-step-failure-signature signature, and passedOnRerun: true on a failure that then passed when its jobs were re-run, which keeps the run id) and keeps the `window` most recent. Groups the failures by signature, most recently seen first: count, run ids oldest first, first and last seen (run, commit, time), and a verdict: 'flaky' when a commit it failed on also passed in the window (a rerun that passed included, passedOnRerun too), or when on one branch it alternated with passes at least twice (fail, pass, fail); else 'new' when seen once (in the latest failed run, or in an older one it has not recurred since) and no failure after it lacks a signature; 'recurring' otherwise. Only failures are grouped; runs with no signature count in the window and are in no group. Also returns the latest run and its signature, or null.
